name: Hengli Petrochemical
description: Private Chinese refiner-petrochemical producer (Suzhou-based Hengli Group; listed company 600346.SH). Operates the integrated crude-to-chemicals complex on Changxing Island, Dalian — a 20-million-tonne-per-year (about 400,000 b/d) refining and chemical integration project with paraxylene, ethylene and PTA units. US OFAC placed the company under sanctions on 2026-04-24 (company denies the grounds); recorded here as an operational fact, not a judgement.
products: Changxing Island (Dalian) crude-to-chemicals complex, about 400,000 b/d refining plus PX and ethylene units
